title: European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) assembly and sequence records
maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

formats.description: ENA Browser API assembly record as XML (ASSEMBLY_SET > ASSEMBLY), from https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/xml/<GCA>. Assembly facts plus a grouped chromosome list and assembly statistics.
ENA Browser API /summary/<GCA> JSON. Same content as the XML in a different shape, plus newAccession (latest version of the chain).
formats.record_key: accession + '.' + version (accession alone is the unversioned chain)

formats.description: ENA Portal API search result=assembly, fields=all, as TSV (format=tsv) or JSON (format=json). One row per assembly version.
formats.record_key: assembly_set_accession (versioned); accession and assembly_accession are the unversioned chain

formats.description: ENA Portal API search result=sequence, fields=all, as TSV. One row per INSDC sequence record, including sequence_md5.
ENA FTP assembly sequence report, https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/ena/assembly/GCA_xxx/GCA_xxxxxx/<GCA>_sequence_report.txt. One row per sequence in the assembly.
formats.record_key: accession (unique within the file; the assembly accession is only in the file name)

formats.description: ENA FTP assembly regions file, <GCA>_regions.txt. One row per alternate-locus scaffold and where it sits on a chromosome. Only exists for assemblies with alt loci (human, not yeast).

ENA CRAM Reference Registry (a GA4GH refget 2.0 server, md5 only) sequence metadata, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/cram/sequence/<id>/metadata. Example files hold one served response per line (JSON Lines).
Webin-CLI genome submission chromosome list file (submitter input, not served back). Tab or whitespace separated, no header, 3-4 columns.
formats.record_key: OBJECT_NAME (unique within a submission); CHROMOSOME_NAME is also unique within an assembly

formats.description: Webin-CLI genome submission unlocalised list file (submitter input). Two columns, no header: sequence name and the chromosome it belongs to.

fields.description: Versioned INSDC assembly accession (GCA_ chain accession + '.' + version).
fields.notes: Optional in the XSD (SRA.common ObjectType) but always present in served records. GCA accessions are shared by all INSDC members (NCBI GenBank, ENA, DDBJ); RefSeq GCF_ accessions are NCBI-only and never appear in ENA.

fields.description: Submitter's name for the object; unique within the submitter's account (SRA.common ObjectType).
fields.notes: Equals NAME for the anchors (GRCh38, R64). Namespace is center_name.
Free text, e.g. 'Genome Reference Consortium', 'Saccharomyces Genome Database'. Acts as the namespace for alias and SUBMITTER_ID.

fields.description: Name of the broker that submitted for the center.
fields.notes: Declared in the spec; not present in any collected record.

fields.description: Primary INSDC identifier of the record.
fields.notes: Same value as @accession.
Declared in the spec; not present in any collected record. Adapter returns a list of strings.

fields.description: Identifiers from non-INSDC resources, each with a namespace.
fields.notes: Declared in the spec; not present in any collected record. Adapter returns a list of {'@namespace', '#text'} objects.
Declared in the spec; not present in any collected record.
GRCh38 / R64 for the anchors (same as NAME).

fields.description: Free-text description. Contains HTML markup (escaped in the XML).

fields.description: Assembly name as given by the submitter.
fields.notes: Not unique across centers. The patch suffix is part of the name: GCA_000001405.15 is 'GRCh38', GCA_000001405.29 is 'GRCh38.p14'.

fields.description: Highest level of assembly: 'complete genome', 'chromosome', 'scaffold' or 'contig' (XSD enumeration).

fields.description: Chromosome list: which INSDC sequences are chromosomes/organelles and their names. List of {@accession, NAME, TYPE}.
fields.notes: Not the full sequence list: unplaced and alt scaffolds are left out, and unlocalised scaffolds are listed under their chromosome name. To get every sequence use ena_sequence_report or portal sequence_accession. Example truncated to the first 4 of 44 items.

fields.description: INSDC accession.version of the sequence, OR a range of accessions.
fields.notes: Consecutive unlocalised scaffolds are collapsed into a range, e.g. 'KI270706.1-KI270714.1' (9 sequences). Expand before matching.
Not unique within the record: unlocalised scaffolds repeat their chromosome's name. INSDC chromosome names never contain 'chr' (Webin rule), so 'chr1'-style names belong to other systems.

fields.description: Replicon type: Chromosome, Mitochondrion, Plasmid, Chloroplast, Linkage Group, ... (XSD enumeration of 22 values).
Links to downloadable files for the assembly; list of link objects.
fields.notes: Absent for the anchors. For WGS assemblies ENA lists the WGS set flat file and FASTA. Example value from examples/other/assembly_xml_GCA_902167145.1.xml (non-anchor real record).

fields.description: Label of the link, e.g. WGS_SET_FASTA, WGS_SET_FLATFILE.
